Theorem
[Weak Harnack inequality] 1. ch9:9.22\group chapter-9Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0258 Let $u\in W^{2,n}(\Omega )$ satisfy $Lu\le f$, with $f\in L^n(\Omega )$, and assume $u\ge 0$ in $B_{2R}(y)\subset \Omega $. There are $p,C>0$, depending only on $n,\gamma , u R^2$, such that egin{equation} ag {9.52} \left( rac1{|B_R|}\int _{B_R(y)}u^p ight)^{1/p} \le C\left(\inf _{B_R(y)}u+ rac R\lambda \| f\| _{L^n(B_{2R}(y))} ight). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Normalize the ball and $\lambda $, and set

egin{equation} ag {9.53} ar u=u+\varepsilon +\| f\| _n,\qquad w=-\log ar u,\qquad v=\eta w,\qquad g=f/ ar u. \end{equation}

Take $\eta =(1-|x|^2)^ eta $. The contact-set estimate gives

egin{equation} ag {9.54} \sup _Bv\leq C(1+\| v^+\| _{n;B_\alpha }). \end{equation}

The contact-set estimate bounds $\sup v$ unless the positive set of $v$ has large relative measure. More precisely, if $K=K_r(z)$ and

egin{equation} ag {9.55} |K^+|\leq heta |K|, \end{equation}

then

egin{equation} ag {9.56} \sup _{K_{3nr}(z)}w\leq C(n,\gamma , u ). \end{equation}

Lemma 53 then yields the power decay

\[ |\{ ar u>t\} \cap K|\le C(\inf _K ar u/t)^\kappa . ag {9.60} \]

The distribution identity gives, for $p<\kappa $,

egin{equation} ag {9.61} \int _{B_\alpha } ar u^p \leq C(\inf _{B_\alpha } ar u)^p. \end{equation}

Let $\varepsilon \downarrow 0$, cover the half-radius ball, and rescale.
